_comment: Hand-curated DMV signature events. This file is the 'signature' layer of
the events service: the annual festivals, parades, and specialty markets
that no free feed carries, because each one lives only on its own site.
Deliberately NOT dated. An annual festival moves by a week or two each
year, and inventing a precise 2026 date we cannot verify would be worse
than saying 'weekends, late August through October'. Each entry therefore
carries an approximate annual window plus human schedule text, and the
adapter emits it in the recurring shape (starts_at null, schedule_text
set) — the same shape farmers markets use.
annual_window months are inclusive, MM-DD. Coordinates were resolved once
by geocoding `address` and are committed here so no lookup happens at
request time. Re-run scripts/geocode_curated_events.py after editing an

annual_window bounds are inclusive, MM-DD. Coordinates were resolved once by geocoding `address` against OpenStreetMap and are committed here so no lookup happens at request time. Re-run `python3 -m backend.services.events_service.geocode_curated --write` after editing an address.

events.title: Maryland Renaissance Festival
events.blurb: A 27-acre Tudor village of jousting, turkey legs, and 200-odd performers, running every weekend from late summer into autumn.
events.schedule_text: Weekends, late August through late October

events.title: National Cherry Blossom Festival
events.blurb: Four weeks around peak bloom at the Tidal Basin — the parade, the kite festival, and the crowds that come with them.
events.address: 1850 West Basin Drive SW, Washington, DC 20024
events.schedule_text: Late March through mid-April, around peak bloom

events.title: Smithsonian Folklife Festival
events.blurb: Free open-air festival on the Mall built around living cultural traditions, with a different region or theme each year.
events.address: Smithsonian Institution Building, 1000 Jefferson Drive SW, Washington, DC 20560

events.title: Independence Day on the National Mall
events.blurb: The parade down Constitution Avenue, the Capitol concert, and fireworks over the Washington Monument.

events.title: DC Jazz Festival
events.blurb: A week of jazz across the city, anchored by free waterfront stages at The Wharf.

events.title: Fiesta DC
events.blurb: The city's largest Latino festival — a parade of nations plus food and music stages along Pennsylvania Avenue.

events.title: H Street Festival
events.blurb: Eleven blocks of H Street NE closed off for a day: a dozen stages, street food, and neighbourhood vendors.
events.address: H Street NE & 8th Street NE, Washington, DC 20002

events.title: Adams Morgan Day
events.blurb: One of the oldest neighbourhood festivals in the city, along 18th Street NW.

events.title: Capital Pride Parade & Festival
events.blurb: The parade through Dupont and Logan, followed by a street festival on Pennsylvania Avenue.
events.address: 17th Street NW & P Street NW, Washington, DC 20036

events.title: Library of Congress National Book Festival
events.blurb: A free one-day festival with a hundred-plus authors across a dozen stages.
events.address: Walter E. Washington Convention Center, Washington, DC
events.schedule_text: A Saturday in late August or early September

events.title: Passport DC — Around the World Embassy Tour
events.blurb: Dozens of embassies open their doors for a weekend of food, music, and rooms you cannot otherwise walk into.

events.title: Kennedy Center Open House Arts Festival
events.blurb: The whole building free for a day — dance, orchestras, and hip-hop across every stage and the roof terrace.

events.title: Georgetown GLOW
events.blurb: A winter walking trail of outdoor light installations through Georgetown, free and after dark.

events.title: Downtown Holiday Market
events.blurb: Six weeks of open-air stalls outside the Portrait Gallery — local makers, and the closest thing DC has to a Christkindlmarkt.
events.schedule_text: Daily, noon to 8pm, late November through 23 December

events.title: National Christmas Tree Lighting
events.blurb: The tree on the Ellipse, lit by the President; the surrounding Pathway of Peace stays up all season.
events.schedule_text: Lighting in early December; display through the season

events.title: Eastern Market Weekend Market
events.blurb: The 1873 market hall on Capitol Hill, with the outdoor farmers' line on Saturdays and the flea market both days.

events.title: Union Market
events.blurb: A converted wholesale warehouse in NE — food hall, rooftop, and a rotating programme of night markets and screenings.

events.title: DC State Fair
events.blurb: A city-scale county fair: best pie, biggest vegetable, and a funniest-looking-produce category taken very seriously.

events.title: Del Ray Halloween Parade
events.blurb: A costume parade down Mount Vernon Avenue with a dog contest that outdraws the children's one.

events.title: Art on the Avenue
events.blurb: A mile of Mount Vernon Avenue given over to 300-odd makers, plus stages and street food.

events.title: Alexandria Scottish Christmas Walk Parade
events.blurb: Pipe bands and clan tartans through Old Town on the first Saturday of December.

events.title: Old Town Alexandria Farmers' Market
events.blurb: Running since 1753 in Market Square — among the oldest continuously operating markets in the country.

events.title: Clarendon Day
events.blurb: Arlington's big street festival — two stages, a 5K, and Wilson Boulevard closed to traffic.

events.title: Viva! Vienna!
events.blurb: Memorial Day weekend carnival and craft fair through the centre of Vienna.

events.title: Wolf Trap Filene Center Summer Season
events.blurb: The only national park built for the performing arts — an outdoor amphitheatre where the lawn tickets are the point.
events.address: Wolf Trap National Park for the Performing Arts, Virginia

events.title: Shenandoah Apple Blossom Festival
events.blurb: Winchester's week-long spring festival, going since 1924 — two parades, a carnival, and orchards in bloom.
events.schedule_text: Ten days, late April into early May

events.title: Leesburg Flower & Garden Festival
events.blurb: Historic downtown Leesburg turned over to growers and garden makers for a weekend each spring.
events.address: King Street & Market Street, Leesburg, VA 20176

events.title: Occoquan Arts & Crafts Show
events.blurb: A riverside town of 1,000 people that takes on 300 craft vendors twice a year.
events.schedule_text: A weekend in late September, and again in early June

events.title: Takoma Park Folk Festival
events.blurb: A free all-day festival of seven stages, no headliners, and a strict all-volunteer rule since 1978.
events.address: 7611 Piney Branch Road, Takoma Park, MD 20912

events.title: Kensington Day of the Book Festival
events.blurb: Howard Avenue closed off for a street fair entirely about books — authors, poets, and secondhand stalls.

events.title: Greenbelt Labor Day Festival
events.blurb: A four-day town festival in one of the New Deal's planned communities, running since 1955.

events.title: Montgomery County Agricultural Fair
events.blurb: Nine days of livestock judging, tractor pulls, and fried everything, twenty miles from the Capitol.

events.title: Maryland State Fair
events.blurb: Timonium's eleven-day state fair — thoroughbred racing, agriculture halls, and a midway.
events.schedule_text: Late August into Labor Day weekend

events.title: Glen Echo Park Spanish Ballroom Dances
events.blurb: Contra, swing, and waltz in a 1933 ballroom inside a former amusement park, most weekends of the year.
events.schedule_text: Most Friday, Saturday, and Sunday evenings

events.title: Artscape
events.blurb: Billed as the largest free arts festival in the country — three days across Baltimore's Station North.
